brief:
In al-Mughayyir, a village northeast of Ramallah, Palestinian students must pass Israeli soldiers stationed near the settlement to attend classes, according to Al Jazeera English. The military presence has become a routine barrier to education for children in the community.

The checkpoint creates daily obstacles for the village's young people seeking to reach their school. Such conditions exemplify the wider challenges facing Palestinian education under Israeli occupation.
dek: In al-Mughayyir, a village north-east of Ramallah, going to school means passing soldiers just to get to class.
title: Israeli soldiers obstruct school access in occupied West Bank village
